title: Code and data for: AI, Fiscal Space, and Universal Social Protection in Emerging Economies
description: Release-candidate reproduction package for a calibrated accounting-fiscal threshold framework computing AI-induced effective fiscal space, gross-cost feasibility ratios, threshold inversions, historical fiscal-capture plausibility, Monte Carlo crossing probabilities, falsification diagnostics, and paper-ready tables for Peru, Chile, Colombia, and Mexico.
